projects.name: Electropia
projects.shortDescription: Multi-vendor electronics marketplace for Bangladesh with a web storefront, merchant and affiliate dashboards, and a mobile app.
projects.fullDescription: A full electronics marketplace: a Bangla-first Next.js storefront, a NestJS + Prisma API on PostgreSQL, admin, merchant and affiliate portals, and an Expo mobile app. Merchants open verified shops and list catalogue products with variants, specs, add-ons and tiered pricing, while affiliates earn commissions through attribution rules.
features: Bangla storefront with categories, brands and shop pages
Merchant shops with verification, product variants, specs, add-ons and price slabs
Affiliate program with attribution tracking and commission rate rules
Cart, wishlist, orders, payments, refunds and return requests
Wallets and a finance ledger for payouts
Admin roles and permissions, OTP sign-in, Excel and PDF exports
Expo mobile app built with React Query and Zustand

coverImage.alt: Electropia storefront header, categories and shopping benefits

projects.name: Eury AI Platform
projects.shortDescription: AI development SaaS with a web app, a NestJS API and a desktop coding agent.
projects.fullDescription: Eury is an AI platform made of three parts: a Next.js web app with a 3D interface, a NestJS API that handles identity, billing, a managed model gateway and team collaboration, and a Tauri desktop coding agent that runs its agent loop, tools and data store on the user's own machine.
features: AI chat and tasks across OpenAI and Anthropic models with per-task model settings
Usage-based credits, plans, coupons and Stripe billing with webhook handling
Organizations, teams, projects, agent skills, rules and a plugin marketplace
Collab: office document storage with in-browser editing via Collabora (WOPI)
Desktop agent with a sandboxed workspace, tool layer, approval policies and PKCE device sign-in

coverImage.alt: Eury AI landing page: one subscription for every leading AI model

projects.name: Optimizify
projects.shortDescription: YouTube growth platform with keyword strategy, thumbnails, native ads, a Chrome extension and AI transcription.
projects.fullDescription: A SaaS platform for YouTube creators. A Laravel core and a React + TypeScript app cover keyword strategy, thumbnail generation, native ad orders and live-stream tools, with Stripe billing. Around it sit a Chrome extension that shows video stats on YouTube, a Django REST API and a self-hosted Whisper transcription service.
features: Keyword strategies, thumbnail templates and generation logs
Native ads ordering with balance top-ups, auto-refill and promo codes
Live stream, channel and calendar tools
Admin email automation with a drag-and-drop template builder and scheduled campaigns
Chrome extension (Manifest v3) that injects video stats into YouTube watch pages
Whisper transcription API for audio and video, with SRT and VTT output

coverImage.alt: Optimizify landing page: AI-powered YouTube SEO and video optimisation

projects.name: All About The Options
projects.shortDescription: Options-trading education and market-data platform with web, admin and mobile apps.
projects.fullDescription: A subscription platform for options traders: courses and documents, live market data with time and sales, price alerts and chat. A Laravel API powers a React web app, a React admin panel and an Expo mobile app, with Stripe and PayPal subscriptions and SMS and push notifications.
features: Courses, programs and course documents
Live market data, time and sales, market closures and alerts
Real-time market data ingestion over WebSockets
Member chat and a news portal
Stripe and PayPal subscriptions with history and webhooks
SMS via Twilio and push notifications to mobile devices

projects.name: Best in Rome Tour
projects.shortDescription: Tour marketplace with vendor accounts, Bókun synchronisation, online payments and settlements.
projects.fullDescription: A multi-vendor tour booking marketplace. Vendors manage tours, options and availability (or sync them from Bókun on a background queue with live progress), customers book and pay with Stripe, and the platform handles reviews, coupons, cancellations, settlement invoices and a full admin back office.
features: Tours with options, availability, images, versions and an approval workflow
Queued Bókun sync with live progress, stop and resume
Stripe payments, coupons and cancellation requests
Vendor profiles, settlement invoices and PDF invoices with QR codes
Reviews, blog with comment moderation, newsletter and partnership inquiries
Real-time notifications and transactional emails

coverImage.alt: Best in Rome Tour homepage with tour search

gallery.alt: Best in Rome Tour homepage hero slide

projects.name: Courtesy Express
projects.shortDescription: Courier and delivery operations system with route optimisation and live driver tracking.
projects.fullDescription: Operations software for a courier company: customers, orders and projects are planned into routes, optimised through Routific, and tracked through driver activity webhooks and a registered driver app, with real-time updates in the dispatch dashboard.
features: Customers, addresses, orders and pricing packages
Projects, routes and schedules with Routific route optimisation
Driver activity and shipping events via webhooks
Driver app device registration and delivery exceptions
Real-time dispatch updates and Excel import/export

projects.name: Lerenjo Solar CRM
projects.shortDescription: Solar installation CRM with a web dashboard and a Flutter field app.
projects.fullDescription: A CRM for a solar installation business that tracks every job from lead to installation: lead forms and documents, payments and financing, delivery challans, panel, battery and inverter inventory, and a complaints workflow. Field teams use a Flutter app with OTP sign-in and role-based menus.
features: Leads with forms, files, customised documents, payments and NBFC financing
Inventory for solar panels, batteries, GTI inverters, kits and vehicles
Delivery challans, drivers and branch management
Complaints with comments and status history
Role-based access for admins, project managers, Surya Mitras, technicians and customers
Flutter app with OTP login, document scanning and camera capture

projects.name: Lerenjo E-commerce
projects.shortDescription: Regional e-commerce platform with vendor stock, district-based selling and coordinator commissions.
projects.fullDescription: An e-commerce platform with a Laravel + Vue back office and a Next.js storefront. Products have variants and stock lots, selling is controlled by allowed vendors and district groups, and coordinators earn commission payouts on orders.
features: Products with variants, images, stock lots, reviews and favourites
Orders with estimates, payments and status history
Allowed vendors and district groups
Coordinator commission payouts and GST records
Promo codes, homepage banners, FAQs and newsletter
OTP login and QR codes

projects.name: PAC DealServe
projects.shortDescription: Ad-operations reporting and support platform for advertisers, campaigns and ad zones.
projects.fullDescription: An ad-operations platform that tracks advertisers, campaign insertion orders and ad zones, aggregates slot, domain and analytics reports, manages subscriptions with reminders, and includes a support ticketing system, with automated backups to Google Drive.
features: Advertisers, agents, clients and campaign insertion orders
Ad zone, slot, domain and track summary reports
Manual and analytics report imports
Subscriptions with reminders
Support tickets with messages, attachments and activity logs
Scheduled backups to Google Drive

projects.name: PAC Self Serve
projects.shortDescription: Self-serve portal where advertisers manage ad zones, campaigns, subscriptions and support.
projects.fullDescription: A self-serve companion to PAC DealServe: a Laravel API with an Inertia React admin and a Next.js + Material UI client portal, covering advertiser ad zones, insertion orders, subscriptions, tickets and in-app notifications, with group- and module-based permissions.
features: Advertiser ad zones and campaign insertion orders
Subscriptions and reminders
Support tickets with attachments and activity logs
In-app notifications to selected recipients
Groups and modules for permissions

projects.name: Avenza
projects.shortDescription: Booking operations tool that syncs Bókun bookings and automates customer communication.
projects.fullDescription: An operations dashboard for tour companies: bookings and experiences are imported from Bókun with processing logs, and booking communications go out over SMS through Twilio, with multi-company accounts, manager profiles and role-based access.
features: Bókun booking and experience sync with processing logs
Booking communications via Twilio SMS
Companies, manager profiles and stored payment cards
Roles and permissions

projects.name: Ticket Management System
projects.shortDescription: Support ticketing system that turns incoming emails into tickets in real time.
projects.fullDescription: A Laravel + Vue helpdesk that fetches emails over IMAP (Gmail and other providers) and converts them into ticket conversations, with email filters, social sign-in and real-time updates for agents.
features: IMAP email fetching converted into tickets and messages
Email filters
Real-time ticket updates
Social login and verification

projects.name: Revadops
projects.shortDescription: Content and media website with a full CMS for blog, ads, pricing and site layout.
projects.fullDescription: A Laravel + Vue website and admin CMS covering blog posts with comments, blog ad placements, a gallery, pricing plans, testimonials, FAQs, contact submissions and configurable site layout.
features: Blog posts, comments and ad settings
Gallery, pricing plans, testimonials and FAQs
Contact submissions and a service file downloader
Configurable site layout

coverImage.alt: Revadops homepage: digital media ad operations for publishers

projects.name: Nordova
projects.shortDescription: Multilingual tour and transfer booking platform with quotes, customer accounts and an admin dashboard.
projects.fullDescription: A booking site for tours and private transfers (one-way or hourly), available in multiple languages, with quote requests, customer accounts and an admin dashboard that includes Bókun management. Its Laravel backend extends the Best in Rome Tour platform with wallets and withdrawals.

coverImage.alt: Nordova booking site homepage with the transfer search form

features: Tour and transfer booking (one-way and hourly)
Quote requests
Customer accounts with email verification and OTP
Language-based routes
Admin dashboard with Bókun management
Wallets and withdrawals

projects.name: Aetherix Mail Server API
projects.shortDescription: JSON email API that queues and delivers mail for other Aetherix projects.
projects.fullDescription: A small Laravel service used by several projects (including this portfolio's contact form): a single JSON endpoint accepts recipients, subject and HTML or text, queues the email, and sends it over SMTP, with optional per-request SMTP configuration.
features: POST /api/send-mail with validation
Queued delivery with a worker
Optional per-request SMTP host, credentials and sender
